development_definition: training plus validation; the validation partition is the 10% middle split
deterministic_assignment: fixed seed and deterministic hash order within each label, launch-period, and overlap-group stratum

supervised_population.censored_rows: retain in quality tables and exclude from supervised partitions
supervised_population.training_imbalance: when the complete population is not 1:1, use all training rows and document class weights or training-only sampling

evaluation.threshold_and_calibration: fit on training and validation only
evaluation.chronological_stress_test: optional secondary analysis, not the primary split
